decisions.reason: As the flagship product shown prominently on the home page, it is likely performing at or above the firm's aspirations, so no problemistic search is triggered.
Being close to the firm's established offer and launched as a product line, its results are expected to align with past performance and industry growth, meeting aspirations.

Although the home automation server box is less central and more uncertain, organisational slack and the absence of clear shortfall signals make management inclined to carry it while exploring alternative uses.
As a luminaire family close to the established offer and presented on its own page, it likely compares favourably with aspirations and remains a core part of the portfolio.
